_readme: 公開APIルートのallowlist正本 (P0 #39)。実装のルート追加/削除/変更は scripts/route-gate.mjs が検知してFAILします。変更手順: SECレビューでreview_idを発番 → route-gate --print-routes の出力でroutesを置換 → sec_reviews にエントリ追記 → コミットメッセージにreview_id記載。sec_reviews の追記なしにroutesを書き換えるとRG2でFAILします。

GET /ard/entries/:file・/ard/openapi.json・/ard/stats.json 追加（読取専用・公開データ・DB非接触・PIIなし・IP非記録）。Codex 審査 P1（形違いデータで起動停止）は 1fcfc00 で修正、Claude 独立試験 21 通りで確認。Founder批准 2026-10-15。正本=founder-ops/SEC-REVIEW-2026-10-14-001_Route-ARD-Entries.md

Agent Stars field-note routes (4 public + 1 admin hide): strict input, length limits, explicit sharing, redaction, no IP stored, 10/min/IP, daily caps 200/1000, write kill switch, hide-not-delete moderation, unverified status. Implemented by Codex, reviewed by Claude (P1 x2 closed in fceffe94; P1-3 distribution of free text deferred while store is empty). Founder ratified 2026-10-20. Canonical: founder-ops/SEC-REVIEW-2026-10-20-001_Route-AgentNotes.md

ask v1 read-only lookup (3 public + 1 admin): length limits, 30/min/IP, daily cap 5000, returns verified/lived only, untrusted_data, no reflection. ask_log stores no question text, words or IP (service, known error key, sha256 of masked text, counts only); unknown provider codes nulled; kill switch stops DB and log line; malformed JSON answered without logging the body (all JSON routes). Implemented by Claude Code agent, reviewed by Claude and Codex (FAIL x2 → PASS at 13d0c518). Founder ratified 2026-10-21. Canonical: founder-ops/SEC-REVIEW-2026-10-21-001_Route-Ask.md

GET /admin/activity: read-only founder watch summary behind the admin secret. Counts, daily-cap usage, latest 20 notes (public text only, 200 chars, hidden notes without body), ask counts and top unmatched keys, alerts. No IPs, raw user agents, question text or hashes; writes nothing; no-store. Reviewed by Claude. Founder ratified 2026-10-21. Canonical: founder-ops/SEC-REVIEW-2026-10-21-002_Route-AdminActivity.md

GET /admin/site-checks: read-only summary of the free site checker log behind the admin secret. Window 1-365 days; totals, per-day counts, grades, score bands, top 20 domains, latest 100 (id, domain, score, grade, time); CSV option. Domains only (no paths), never ip_hash values (distinct count only) or raw signals; writes nothing; no-store. Reviewed by Claude. Founder ratified 2026-10-22. Canonical: founder-ops/SEC-REVIEW-2026-10-22-001_Route-AdminSiteChecks.md
